scope: Bärenz--Barrett Lemma 3.3, equations (3.1.2)-(3.1.11), relative to explicit standard pivotal, spherical, and semisimple inputs.

trusted_input_boundary.meaning: The dimension-weighted simple-channel resolution of one identity.
trusted_input_boundary.does_not_assume: No sliding endpoint equality is assumed.

trusted_input_boundary.meaning: A pivotal strong monoidal functor preserves the spherical trace pairing.
trusted_input_boundary.does_not_assume: No mate transport or sliding equality is assumed.

trusted_input_boundary.meaning: The two concrete Frobenius mate maps preserve the spherical pairing.
trusted_input_boundary.does_not_assume: Transported dual-family equations are derived, not supplied.

trusted_input_boundary.meaning: Each local braiding or cup/cap replacement carries its own evaluator equality.
trusted_input_boundary.source_locator: Equation (3.1.5), equation (3.1.10), and Mathlib braided/rigid identities
trusted_input_boundary.does_not_assume: There is no whole-chain or endpoint-equality field.

trusted_input_boundary.meaning: The two endpoint formal sums are natural in the strand object.
trusted_input_boundary.does_not_assume: Pointwise generalized sliding is derived independently.

silent_failure_guards: The image of a source basis is represented only as a biorthogonal family; fullness of the pivotal functor is never inferred.
The forward and oppositely oriented mate maps have different Hom-space types and exact-pairing orders.
Kirby colours remain free-module linear combinations until the final API collapse.
The slide law is an endomorphism of the functor fixed_tensor_minus, not incorrectly of the identity functor.
Forward and backward identity resolutions are both required.
The backward channels are definitionally the same mated family whose Kronecker pairing is certified.
Every braiding and mate channel change carries a kernel-checked movie.
The final core equality is a theorem and is not a structure field.
explicit_non_claims: Mathlib v4.29.1 has no native pivotal or spherical category class; the two standard trace-pairing consequences are explicit source-backed hypotheses.
This does not formalize Lemma 3.4 for arbitrary framed knots and multiple linked strands.
This does not formalize all framed-link isotopy or Kirby-calculus completeness.
This does not prove four-manifold invariance.
This does not connect computation JSON artifacts to Lean.
This does not assert that an arbitrary linear strong monoidal functor is pivotal.
